options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: extra_parameters
options.description: Extra parameter is appended at the end of tcp server service command.

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), append JOBLOG to stderr/stderr_lines.

options.name: name_list
options.description: The name of the tcp server service. The valid value are C(*ALL), C(*AUTOSTART), C(*BOOTP), C(*DBG), C(*DDM), C(*DHCP), C(*DIRSRV), C(*DLFM), C(*DNS), C(*DOMINO), C(*EDRSQL), C(*FTP), C(*HTTP), C(*HOD), C(*IAS), C(*INETD), C(*LPD), C(*MGTC), C(*NETSVR), C(*NSLD), C(*NTP), C(*ODPA), C(*OMPROUTED), C(*ONDMD), C(*POP), C(*QOS), C(*REXEC), C(*ROUTED), C(*SLP), C(*SMTP), C(*SNMP), C(*SRVSPTPRX), C(*SSHD), C(*TCM), C(*TELNET), C(*TFTP), C(*VPN), C(*WEBFACING).

options.name: state
options.description: C(started)/C(stopped) are idempotent actions that will not run commands unless necessary.
